name: llm-relay
description: Loopback bidirectional Anthropic/OpenAI API proxy with tool-call validation and multi-provider routing.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm test
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/install-skill.mjs || node -e "process.stderr.write('llm-relay: the postinstall hook crashed, so the bundled host skills and Codex setup were NOT fully installed. The package itself is fine. Retry with: node scripts/install-skill.mjs --force\n')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check
